course: Migration & the Making of Modern Teesside

lessons.title: Pinpoint the Place
lessons.sow: Autumn 2 · Week 2 · GROW Weekly – Autumn B54:C54
lessons.outcome: Use an atlas and grid references to describe location.
lessons.enquiry: How can a grid reference make a location precise without pretending a map shows everything?

lessons.title: Teesside: Connected World
lessons.sow: Autumn 2 · Week 3 · GROW Weekly – Autumn B55:C55
lessons.outcome: Describe how communities are connected across the world.
lessons.enquiry: How can maps and sources show connections without reducing a community to one route or statistic?

lessons.title: Light Across the Map
lessons.sow: Autumn 2 · Week 4 · GROW Weekly – Autumn B56:C56
lessons.outcome: Investigate festivals of light around the world.
lessons.enquiry: How do place, movement and community shape where a festival is celebrated—without making faith equal nationality?

lessons.title: Compare With Care
lessons.sow: Autumn 2 · Week 5 · GROW Weekly – Autumn B57:C57
lessons.enquiry: How can we compare celebrations accurately while protecting difference within each community?

lessons.title: Belonging Briefing
lessons.sow: Autumn 2 · Week 6 · GROW Weekly – Autumn B58:C58
lessons.outcome: Present findings on belief and belonging.
lessons.enquiry: How can I communicate a careful map-and-source finding so an audience can restate it accurately?

lessons.title: Map & Belonging Challenge ★
lessons.sow: Autumn 2 · Week 7 · GROW Weekly – Autumn B59:C59
lessons.outcome: Complete a belief-and-belonging task and map-skills check; evidence may be banked only through centre verification.
lessons.enquiry: How securely can I use map and source evidence to explain belief and belonging independently?
